title: Planting Cover Crops with Multiple Species Mix
reason: Discusses the reasons and benefits of planting cover crops.

tasks.task: Explain the process of planting cover crops.

subtasks.text: Describe the oats field that was harvested and immediately turned into a cover crop field.
Outline the composition of the 21-species cover crop mix.
Emphasize the importance of maintaining a proper carbon to nitrogen ratio.

tasks.task: Detail the benefits of using cover crops.

subtasks.text: Highlight the goal of increasing soil organic matter.
Note the intention to improve water infiltration and nutrient cycling.
Mention the aim of reducing synthetic fertilizers through cover crops.
